messages:
sara-oncall: Handing off — quick async standup. INC-2219 (routing fallback) is active. What I did: pinned traffic to model-v2-temp for affected routes, bumped kvcache TTL to 30s to reduce churn, scaled dedicated pool (ded-pool-3) +2 replicas. Observed: p99 token latency jumped to ~1.2s (baseline ~0.45s) for multi-turn chat in us-east-1. Blockers: canary rollback blocked — config flag didn't propagate from confd; PR merged but not reconciled. Logs: `curl -s http://ops.internal/alerts/INC-2219` — trace id: 0a1b2c.

raj-sre: Saw the tail latencies too. ded-pool-3 CPU at 82% and some OOM restarts on quant-small instances. I'll drain the extra tasks and check kernel OOM logs. Can take snapshot of kvcache before any invalidation.

mike-eng: Re: rollback flag — PR #3721 merged but confd hasn't picked it up. I can force the config patch if we decide. Command I have ready:
```
kubectl patch configmap model-routing -n redwood -p '{"data":{"canary_enabled":"false"}}'
```
Do you want me to run it? Note: that will route traffic back to model-v2 which is larger.

tanya-devex: FYI CS flagged degraded responses from customer AcmeCorp (ticket #AC-987). They've seen timeouts on some batch jobs. I'm adding a short note to the incident doc and CCing support.

sara-oncall: Please don't patch until we confirm model compatibility for those sessions — last time a forced switch triggered tokenization mismatches. Raj, can you snapshot current kvcache and metadata? If rollback causes mismatches we'll need a restore plan.

raj-sre: Snapshot created: s3://redwood-snapshots/INC-2219/1768881234.tar.gz — includes kv meta and session pointers. If we need to invalidate, we can restore from here.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary config apply requested by mike-eng at 2026-03-16T15:12:05Z. Watching confd reconciliation. Will post status.

mike-eng: Applied the patch locally and pushed to confd. Waiting for reconciliation — if not reconciled in 2m I'll restart confd on confd-2 (`systemctl restart confd`).

sara-oncall: Also noted a separate low-rate auth error spike (~0.02%) affecting some Private customers (INC-2220) — not related but logged. No action required now.

raj-sre: Next steps for incoming shift: 1) verify p99 returns to baseline after confd reconciles, 2) confirm model routing flag propagation across regions, 3) keep an eye on ded-pool CPU/OOMs and evictions, 4) coordinate with CS for customer updates.

mike-eng: :thumbsup: I'll monitor and post if the confd reconciliation fails; will proceed with controlled rollback only after green from Raj.

tanya-devex: Adding notes to incident doc and updating AcmeCorp ticket with ETA ~30m. Will post customer-facing status if latency persists.

sara-oncall: Thanks all — handing off to @raj-sre for overnight watch. Ping me if anything spikes or if rollback is needed urgently. End of handoff.
